customModel.title: Add custom model
customModel.desc: The file stays where it is — nothing is copied or uploaded.
customModel.hintSdxl: Most Civitai models (SDXL, Pony, Illustrious…) — a single self-contained file.
customModel.hintSd15: Classic Stable Diffusion 1.5 checkpoints — a single self-contained file.
customModel.hintZimage: Transformer-only weights; needs a base repo.
customModel.hintFlux: FLUX.1 transformer-only checkpoint; needs a base repo.
customModel.hintChroma: FLUX-derived (single T5 encoder); needs a base repo.
customModel.hintQwenimage: 20B MMDiT, strong text rendering; needs a base repo.
customModel.hintAnima: Single-file DiT (Cosmos); needs the Anima base repo (Qwen3 encoder + VAE).
customModel.hintKrea2: Krea 2 Turbo transformer-only checkpoint (fp8 or bf16, ComfyUI files load as-is); needs the gated Krea 2 base repo. Heavy: ~13 GB VRAM.
customModel.baseModel: Base model (Hugging Face repo id) — optional
customModel.baseModelHint: Leave blank to use the default ({{base}}).

storage.quotaHint: Downloaded models are kept so switching back is instant. Past this size the least recently used are removed — never the one loaded in the engine.
storage.minFreeHint: A download that would eat into this reserve is refused before it starts.
storage.modelsHint: Removing one frees the space now; you can download it again at any time.
storage.orphanHint: This file couldn't be matched to a catalog model — it will be removed first when space is needed.
storage.deleteConfirm: {{name}} ({{size}}) is removed from disk. You can download it again later.
storage.deleteActiveBlocked: Loaded in the engine — switch to another model first
storage.folderModelsHint: The checkpoints you downloaded — subject to the cache limit above.
storage.folderBaseHint: Text encoders and VAEs shared by every model of a family.
storage.folderEngineHint: The isolated Python environment the app installed.
storage.purgeConfirm: This stops the engine and deletes the shared text encoders and VAEs. They download again the next time a model loads — expect a slower first generation.

runtime.title: Engine / machine
runtime.desc: How each engine runs on your machine. Defaults adapt automatically — change these only to fit your GPU/RAM. Saving restarts the local engine.
runtime.imageModels: — SDXL · SD 1.5 · Z-Image · FLUX · Chroma · Qwen-Image · Anima
runtime.tinyVae: Tiny VAE — much faster decode, slight quality loss (SDXL / SD 1.5 only)
runtime.vaeTiling: VAE tiling — lower decode VRAM for long / large video
runtime.offloadModeAuto: Auto — group for big models on small GPUs (recommended)
runtime.offloadModeModel: Model — whole submodels swap (fast, needs the biggest one to fit)
runtime.offloadModeGroup: Group — block streaming, ~6 GB peak (big models on 8 GB cards; slower, RAM-hungry)

wallet.title: Wallet (Base mainnet · USDC)
wallet.keychainNote: This wallet's private key lives in your OS keychain on this machine (Windows Credential Manager / macOS login keychain). Treat it as a burner: only fund what you're OK losing. Use "Export private key" to back it up before relying on it.
wallet.intro: x402 needs an EVM wallet on Base mainnet to pay per generation (cost varies by model — shown on each cloud model). Recommended: generate a burner wallet here and fund it with a few dollars from your MetaMask.
wallet.fundHint: Fund this address with USDC on Base from your MetaMask (or any wallet). Balance refreshes every 30 s.
wallet.privateKeyLabel: Private key (64 hex chars, with or without 0x prefix)
wallet.importWarning: This will overwrite any existing wallet in your Credential Manager. Make sure you've exported the current one if you want to keep it.
wallet.replaceWarning: The current private key will be overwritten in Credential Manager and is unrecoverable unless you've exported it. Any USDC at the current address will become inaccessible from this app.
wallet.exportWarning: Anyone with this key can spend your USDC. Back it up to a password manager and then close this dialog. We don't log or transmit it.
